name: STOP Sign
meaning: You must come to a complete stop before continuing. Look both ways before moving again.

name: Yield Sign
meaning: You must slow down and let traffic on the other road go first before continuing.

name: Pedestrian Crossing
meaning: This is the right place to cross the street on foot. Look both ways before crossing.

name: No Entry
meaning: You cannot enter this street. It's like a closed door just for cars and bikes.

name: Speed Limit
meaning: Shows the fastest speed allowed on this road. Going slower is always safer near homes and schools.

name: One-Way Street
meaning: On this street you can only go in one direction. Going the wrong way could crash into other cars.

name: Red Traffic Light
meaning: Red means STOP. No one may go, not cars, not pedestrians, until the light changes.

name: Yellow Traffic Light
meaning: Yellow means get ready to stop. The light is about to turn red.

name: Green Traffic Light
meaning: Green means you may go, but still look around before moving.

name: School Zone
meaning: Warns that a school is nearby. Cars must slow down because children may cross.

name: No Parking
meaning: Cars cannot stop and stay here. The spot must stay clear.

name: Roundabout
meaning: A round square where cars go around. Whoever is already inside the roundabout always has priority.

name: Cycle Lane
meaning: A path just for bicycles. Cars should not drive or park here.

name: Crossroads
meaning: Warns that two roads will cross ahead. You need to pay extra attention and slow down.

name: Speed Bump
meaning: A small bump in the road that makes cars go slowly. It helps protect people crossing on foot.

name: General Danger
meaning: This triangle warns there is a danger ahead. Pay close attention and slow down.

name: Level Crossing
meaning: Warns that the road crosses a train track. Always stop and look carefully before crossing — a train cannot stop quickly.

name: No Bicycles
meaning: Bicycles cannot ride here. You need to use another path, like the cycle lane.

name: Hospital
meaning: Warns that a hospital is nearby. Cars should be extra careful and avoid honking, so they don't disturb people who are sick.

name: Priority Road
meaning: Shows that this road has priority over others that cross it. Traffic from side roads must wait.

name: Height Limit
meaning: Warns that tall vehicles, like trucks, don't fit through here. It helps prevent them from hitting a low bridge or tunnel.

name: No Overtaking
meaning: You're not allowed to overtake other vehicles on this road, because it can be dangerous, like near curves.

name: Pedestrian Refuge Island
meaning: A small island in the middle of the road where you can wait safely if you can't cross all the way at once.

name: Helmet Required
meaning: Warns that anyone riding a bike or scooter must always wear a helmet, to protect their head in case of a fall.
